description: Use this tool when a user wants to estimate the cost of a long distance household move between two US states with Cross Country Movers: interstate moving, cross-country moving, moving a 1-4 bedroom home or studio to another state. This is the tool for 'how much to move my house or apartment' to another state. Inputs: origin and destination (city + state or ZIP), home size (studio, 1-4 bedrooms) or cubic feet, optional first available date (YYYY-MM-DD). Returns the route, driving miles, an estimated price range (low end first) for that route and home size, the delivery window and a 'Get your exact price' link (rooms, video or inventory). Some routes return no number and a callback offer instead. Homes of 5+ bedrooms: pass cubic_feet. Estimates only, not binding; nothing is booked. Do not use for local moves within one state, car shipping (use get_quote) or moves outside the US (use get_international_quote).
name: get_long_distance_quote
title: Get long distance moving quote
